description.value:
Mythical Beast Amber — Cursed Technique Reversal

Your mastery of the Reverse Cursed Technique has granted you the reversal of your technique, the ability to turn your body back to flesh after using your Release. As a bonus action, while Mythical Beast Amber Release is active, you can spend 6 cursed energy to start reversing the effects. The amount of time that you were using your Release is now the amount of time it will take to fully reverse the effects. While the technique is active, you must maintain concentration. If you lose concentration, the reversal ends and you must immediately make the saving throw using your current stage's save DC. If you wait for the same amount of time that you had your Release active then your Mythical Beast Amber Release will be deactivated and you do not have to make a saving throw. Even if you spent Cursed Energy to speed up your transformation, you must wait the number of rounds as if you had progressed normally.

system.requirements: Cursed Technique Reversal, Mythical Beast Amber

effects.name: Reversing Amber
effects.description: Concentration; wait as long as the Release lasted to end it safely.
